title: Skeleton King
body:
The Skeleton King is a unique "Boss" Enemy found exclusively in the Acidlands. He has an arena on the opposite side of the island and will drop the Acid Crown and Big Bones when defeated.

Tips:

You can get a vehicle into the arena to push the King out, this is useful to reduce enemy swarming.

You can get the King sitting in a vehicle, which will prevent it from moving (In latest versions, he is capable of "jumping" out).

You can stand on the other side of a vehicle, and he won't be able to hit you, while you can still hit him. You can stand on one of the nearby pillars and shoot at him from range.

Trivia:

The Skeleton King can also drop a "Ribmaul", roughly 20% of the time.

The Skeleton King can also drop a "BIG Skull", roughly 10% of the time.

There can sometimes be two Kings at once.
